notes: Explicit public SoundSpaces 2 / modern RLR reference parameters for room-acoustic calibration experiments.
The values match the public modern RLR context defaults: 44.1 kHz, 4 bands, direct SH3, indirect SH1, 500 direct rays, 5000 indirect rays at depth 200, and 200 source rays at depth 10.
global_volume is explicitly 1.0 because the modern Context API and deprecated Configuration API used different defaults.
This profile does not contain the unpublished FRL Apartment fitted material coefficients, seven source/listener poses, or exact Replica scan identifier, so qualification_claim remains false.
